```{r}

library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)

# 1. Find files 
files <- list.files(
  path      = "indicate-your-path",
  pattern   = "^Erasmus-KA1-Mobility-Data-\\d{4}\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Files found:", length(files), "\n")
print(basename(files))

# 2. Preview column names
lapply(files, function(f) {
  cat("\n---", basename(f), "---\n")
  print(colnames(read_excel(f, n_max = 0)))
})

# 3. Read function
cols_needed <- c("Fewer Opportunities", "Sending Country", "Sending City",
                 "Receiving Country", "Receiving City")

read_erasmus <- function(f) {
  year <- as.integer(str_extract(basename(f), "\\d{4}"))
  df   <- read_excel(f, na = c("", "-"), col_types = "text")  # read all as text
  setDT(df)
  df <- df[, ..cols_needed]
  df[, year := year]
  df
}

erasmus <- rbindlist(
  lapply(files, read_erasmus),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill      = TRUE
)

# Clean broken city names (Unicode replacement character)
broken_sending   <- unique(erasmus$`Sending City`[grepl("\uFFFD",   erasmus$`Sending City`)])
broken_receiving <- unique(erasmus$`Receiving City`[grepl("\uFFFD", erasmus$`Receiving City`)])
#broken city names
print(sort(unique(c(broken_sending, broken_receiving))))

erasmus <- erasmus[
  !grepl("\uFFFD", `Sending City`)   &
  !grepl("\uFFFD", `Receiving City`)
]

#save the data
saveRDS(erasmus, "erasmus_combined.rds")
```
